project.name: Silkscreen Placement Agent
project.summary: A verifiable agent that repairs PCB placement faults and follows a hardware team's explicit layout preferences.
project.ai_usage: Gemini can recover failed placement proposals; deterministic geometry verifies every move; synthetic and failure traces support later Qwen SFT, preference training, and RL.
project.codex_usage: Planning, implementation, testing, integration, and verification support.
